mapping.summary: B2C and B2B webshop with CMS that integrates with BC and other Danish ERPs
claims: Standard templates or fully tailored shop design
Unlimited pages, categories, products, variants, images, videos and documents
Supports both B2C and B2B selling
Integrates with Uniconta, C5, NAV, Business Central and e-conomic
Products, prices, discounts, stock and debtors maintained in the ERP
Webshop orders land directly in the ERP
Several webshops per installation for countries, languages, stores or resellers
Includes an enterprise CMS with SEO tools
Can be hosted on premises, in the cloud or on Azure
